ui_endcard.animation: logo shrink 27.75-28.00; line 1 wipes on left to right 28.00-28.25; line 2 writes on left to right 28.40-28.90; the border grows in from the frame edge 28.42-28.58 (picture scales to 97.8%); all hold to the end
